name: claude-usage
description: All your ccswitch accounts in the sidebar: 5h/weekly usage, most headroom, one-click switch, auto-switch

commands.title: Claude Usage: Toggle auto-switch to most headroom

claudeUsage.autoSwitch.markdownDescription: When the active account reaches 100% (5h or weekly), or the lower percents in `#claudeUsage.autoSwitchAtFiveHour#` / `#claudeUsage.autoSwitchAtWeekly#`, switch Claude Code to the next-best account via ccswitch, **without asking**. It applies to every Claude Code session on this machine, open or new, from its next message. Turning it on asks once in a dialog; if you tick it here or edit settings.json, the sidebar shows that dialog once, and No turns it off. Machine-scoped, so Settings Sync never carries it to another machine.

claudeUsage.autoSwitchAtFiveHour.markdownDescription: Eager auto-switch: the percent of the 5-hour window at which `#claudeUsage.autoSwitch#` switches. 100 = only when that window is full. Set it lower, for example 95, to switch before the limit stops a running task; each account then keeps its last few percent of this window unused. Checked on its own, never mixed with the weekly percent. The target account must be under both percents.

claudeUsage.autoSwitchAtWeekly.markdownDescription: Eager auto-switch: the percent of the weekly window at which `#claudeUsage.autoSwitch#` switches. 100 = only when that window is full. Set it lower, for example 95, to switch before the limit stops a running task; each account then keeps its last few percent of this window unused. Checked on its own, never mixed with the 5-hour percent. The target account must be under both percents.

claudeUsage.usageFile.description: Leave empty to use ccswitch's own usage cache. Set to a team snapshot (CtrlA hub usage.json) to show shared seats instead.
